newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan Linate airport shut briefly by bomb hoax.
newsitem.headline: Milan Linate airport shut briefly by bomb hoax.

text.p: Milan's Linate airport was closed to air traffic for more than an hour and partially evacuated following a bomb hoax on Friday, an airport spokesman said.
Police with sniffer dogs found a suspect package in the check-in area of the domestic departures section after an anonymous telephone caller said there was a bomb there.
Parts of the airport, some 10 km (six miles) east of the centre of Milan, Italy's business capital, were evacuated. Departures were suspended and incoming aircraft diverted to other airports.
The airport spokesman said the suspect package contained only T-shirts. The airport was later reopened.
